mapper.select:
SELECT c.*, a.account_no AS accountNo, u.user_name AS operateUserName FROM account_status_change c LEFT JOIN account a ON a.account_id=c.account_id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.user_id=c.operate_user_id
AND a.account_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{accountNo}, '%')
AND u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{operateUserName}, '%')
ORDER BY c.change_id ASC
